functions.name: freeware_aim_screen_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Startup table entry directly jumps to the screen-aim initializer.

functions.name: freeware_aim_screen_global_init
functions.evidence: Stores 320.0 and 240.0 in the two members of the verified freeware_aim_screen global.

functions.name: unused_sfx_prefix_creature_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Startup thunk jumps directly to the standalone creature constructor.

functions.name: unused_sfx_prefix_creature_global_init
functions.evidence: Initializes the same four fields as the 0x68-byte creature records; this unused single record ends at freeware_sfx_state.

functions.name: freeware_save_score
functions.evidence: Appends the 36-byte name/score pair to rush.top or career.top, selecting elapsed seconds or player experience.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Jumps directly to the static score table initializer.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_global_init
functions.evidence: Constructs the 100 score records with default name 10tons, using the same table as the loader.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_reset
functions.evidence: Called by the score loader before fopen. Visits all 100 score records, assigns the default name and clears scores.

functions.name: highscore_load_table
functions.evidence: Clears the score table, opens rush.top or career.top, reads the 36-byte entries and sorts the table in place.

functions.name: perks_init_database
functions.evidence: The startup caller at 0x0041084e invokes the full registration sequence. It sets sixteen perk ID globals, resolves the perks01 atlas and wraps each name and description into the metadata table.

functions.name: freeware_post_player_render_noop
functions.evidence: Called directly in the frame renderer between player_render and the pickup/particle pass. The complete body is a bare return.

functions.name: freeware_encounter_update
functions.note: Career dispatch by encounter ID. The fifth switch target at 0x40b1ae calls the duct-tape handler and falls through to the shared cursor. The five destination addresses follow the final return.

functions.name: freeware_career_menu_update
functions.note: Shows the current day and experience, handles the three town options, and enters the selected encounter.

functions.name: freeware_read_name_key
functions.evidence: 0x0040e96c polls this helper when entering the high-score name. It tests the DirectInput digit, letter, space, return and backspace scancodes, then uppercases the result while Shift is held.

functions.name: freeware_hud_set_row
functions.evidence: The HUD renderer calls this helper to select the supplied UV row. Its entire compiled function previously matched all 61 bytes with clean positional references.

functions.name: game_frame_update
functions.evidence: The compiled dispatcher covers the complete pinned body. Five interior discovery starts are switch destinations and the sixth is reached by an internal jump. The adjacent jump tables are outside its code extent.

functions.name: freeware_draw_loading_progress
functions.evidence: WinMain calls this with successive progress fractions between asset loads. It draws the Crimsonland logo and a bullet-textured progress bar before presenting the frame.

functions.name: game_highscores_update
functions.evidence: Draws the Highscores: heading, mode labels -SURVIVAL-- and -CAREER----, and rows of the original score table through Grim.

functions.name: crimsonland_main
functions.evidence: The CRT entry calls this four-argument WinMain at 0x00411362 with GetModuleHandleA(NULL) and the startup command line. It opens Grim, loads resources and tears down the game; ret 0x10 releases its four arguments.

functions.name: crt_srand
functions.evidence: Stores the QueryPerformanceCounter seed. The following crt_rand updates that same DWORD as seed*0x343fd+0x269ec3.

functions.name: crt_fseek_nolock
functions.evidence: The score writer seeks to SEEK_END and the reader to SEEK_SET. The unlocked CRT body validates the three seek origins, adjusts SEEK_CUR via ftell, flushes the FILE, and seeks the descriptor.

functions.name: effect_render_all
functions.note: Called from the game frame to draw the pickup, glow and flame particles. The two particle loops traverse the complete 128-entry, 48-byte-stride pool.

data.name: unused_sfx_prefix_creature_global_init
data.evidence: Direct initialization-table thunk destination.

data.name: freeware_encounter_id
data.evidence: 1.0.2 stores 1 + rand() % 5, then 0x40b180 dispatches one of five daily encounters using this index.

data.name: freeware_encounter_page
data.evidence: The daily encounter dialog branches on this page and sets it to 2 when advancing its choice at 0x409ba4.

data.name: freeware_shadows
data.evidence: The shadow pass tests this same byte that the options menu reads to select the Shadows label and toggles at 0x40cd9c.

data.name: freeware_encounter_day
data.evidence: The value supplies the first format argument to "Day %d\nExperience %d" at 0x40b315.

data.name: freeware_music_started
data.evidence: Set immediately after a call to sfx_play_panned(13, .45f, .5f) in the guarded wind-start path.

data.name: unused_sfx_prefix_creature
data.evidence: The constructor zeros the active byte and the fields at offsets +1, +4, and +0x64. The end at +0x68 is the verified SFX state start.

data.name: freeware_encounter_active
data.evidence: Guards the call to the five-way daily encounter dispatcher at 0x40b34d.

data.name: freeware_spawn_enabled
data.evidence: The career encounter enables creature spawning here. The frame reads this flag when scheduling spawns at 0x40d974.

data.name: bonus_fire_bullets_timer
data.evidence: Eight-second fire bullets pickup; controls the same projectile impact paths as the 1.3.0 timer.

data.name: freeware_pickup_time
data.evidence: The projectile death-drop path sets the pickup lifetime to 10 seconds. The frame decrements it at 0x0040cfb6 and clears the pickup ID when it expires.

data.name: freeware_pending_perks
data.evidence: The perk picker consumes one pending choice at 0x40bcdf.

data.name: freeware_next_spawn
data.evidence: The survival spawn countdown resets to 0.2 seconds in the frame.

data.name: aim64_texture
data.evidence: Store of the Grim texture lookup for aim64.

data.name: world_arrow_marker_texture
data.evidence: Store of the arrow handle; 0x40d2f3 binds it with the current player heading for the 32x32 world arrow.

data.name: s_empty_string
data.evidence: Empty C string passed to strdup_malloc for the penultimate option row and assigned to the Grim PAQ config at 0x4106bd.

data.name: freeware_main_labels
data.evidence: Six strdup-owned pointers from Begin. through End.; 0x4106e0 clears 6 DWORDs and the teardown frees all six.

data.name: freeware_option_labels
data.evidence: Nine option labels from Control method: static through Done; cleared and freed as nine pointers.

data.name: freeware_town_choices
data.evidence: Walk around, Go pick a fight, Leave for good; each is duplicated and freed on shutdown.

data.name: config_movement_schemes
data.evidence: The early player updater reads the verified native movement control setting before its control branches.

data.name: freeware_menu_music_pending
data.evidence: Cleared when the title track starts. A new run sets this byte at 0x40ce78.

data.name: freeware_game_active
data.evidence: Changes Begin game. to Resume game. At row zero an active run resumes without resetting gameplay.

data.name: freeware_logo_angle
data.evidence: The menu clamps this computed logo tilt to [0, pi/2] before rotating the Crimsonland title texture.

data.name: freeware_logo_visible
data.evidence: Set after the logo has faded in. Cleared when beginning a new run at 0x40ce71.

data.name: freeware_name_length
data.evidence: The name-entry state resets this edit cursor on entry and updates it when appending and erasing characters in freeware_last_score.name.

absent.name: creature_find_nearest
absent.reason: The ordered placement at 0x00402940 initializes the 8 by 8 sprite UV table. The seeker rocket and its homing target search first appear in 1.3.0.

absent.name: unused_console_prefix_vec2_global_init
absent.note: The startup entries placed here initialize a bonus ID or count. The early builds have no console.

absent.name: unused_console_prefix_vec2_global_init_thunk
absent.note: The startup entries placed here initialize a bonus ID or count. The early builds have no console.

absent.name: console_cmd_tell_time_survived
absent.note: The early build has no console. The heuristic address is an FMOD import thunk.

absent.name: audio_init_sfx
absent.note: The 1.0.2 FMOD initializer at 0x401470 registers the samples itself. The ordered placement at 0x40acc0 calls Grim drawing methods.

rejected_data_placements.name: sprite_effect_pool
rejected_data_placements.reason: This is the entire relocation-free .data section of VC6 libcmt.lib(constpow.obj). The power-of-ten tables __pow10pos and __pow10neg begin here and at +0x160. An operand projected from the later game does not establish a sprite pool here.

rejected_data_placements.name: d3dx_sse_math_bss
rejected_data_placements.reason: player_check_level stores a byte here. The following game globals include the frame delta, advancing simulation clock and menu state, each with an independent write. The 32-byte footprint cannot be the static SIMD zero vector. DirectX 8.1 d3dx8.lib(d3dxmathsse.obj) supplies a 32-byte .bss section with 32-byte alignment containing _zero__9701.
